messages:
Asha: Customer Orion asked for a compact "observability kit": per-route + per-model-version cost rollups, lightweight trace snippets tied to model-call boundaries, and an alerting hook when route spend accelerates. They want to avoid a full tracing backend for now. Can we draft an MVP?
Tom: We should be explicit about granularity: do they want cost by model version (e.g., gpt-3.8q-1) or by model family? Version-level is more useful but adds catalog management.
Luis: I'd vote for version-level but only for last-3 deployed versions per route. Keeps storage bounded. Also suggest we store aggregated 1m rollups for cost (tokens, calls, avg latency) and store only sampled trace snippets (1000/day/customer by default).
Ben: Sampling rules idea: route-level default sampling (0.01), route hot-window sampling ramp (if token_rate > threshold => sample_rate=0.5 for 5m), and customer opt-in full_capture toggle. Example config: ```json
{"sampling": {"default": 0.01, "hot_window_threshold_tokens_s": 2000, "hot_window_rate": 0.5, "customer_overrides": {"customer_orion": 1.0}}}
```
Priya: Important privacy constraint: don't store prompts or user text. Trace snippets should include only model_id, version, token_counts (prompt/response), latency_ms, and a hash pointer to the request id. No PII. Also must honor billing-scrubbed customers and DoNotTrace tags.
Asha: Console surface for MVP: 1) per-route sparkline + 24h cost delta, 2) per-route breakdown by model version (tokens x unit_rate), 3) one-click link to sampled trace snippet (signed URL, TTL 1h). No full trace search.
Tom: Storage options: quick wins = S3 for snippets + Dynamo/OLAP for rollups. Snippet index must support quick lookup from Console with signed URL. Need retention policy UI: default 90d, configurable down to 7d.
Luis: Perf constraints: added median latency <= 5ms; added p99 <= 25ms. Storage write path must be async so runtime ack path unaffected. Runtime will emit small protobuf payload (~<1KB) to a sidecar/ingest queue.
Ben: Launch criteria checklist proposal: - runtime emits events + sampling config controlled by API - cost calc pipeline produces per-route daily rollups - Console shows route cost table + trace snippet link - privacy + KMS checks for Private customers - pilot with Orion and one internal workload - automated perf benchmark (p99 within target)
Priya: Owners: Asha = Console UX + retention settings; Tom = ingestion + storage; Luis = runtime sampling + sidecar; Ben = cost pipeline + alerts; I'll coordinate pilots and compliance. Timeline: spec in 4 business days, alpha rollout to internal + Orion in 4 sprints, GA in 8 sprints contingent on pilot feedback.
Asha: UX question: should we show estimated $/hr burn per route at 95th percentile? Might help customers make decisions.
Tom: We can compute 95th token_rate and multiply by model unit_rate. Cheap to add if rollups exist. Flagging as stretch for MVP.
Luis: Ops ask: emit metric `route.tokens_per_min` and `route.model_infer_latency_ms` to metrics backend for alerting. We'll use alert rule: tokens_per_min > X -> page oncall.
Ben: Also add CSV upload for Private to override unit costs and an API to set per-customer overrides. Keeps enterprise happy.
Priya: Agreement: MVP focuses on rollups + sampled snippets + cost table, keep trace UX minimal. We'll iterate to full search later. Schedule 30m sync once spec posted. :rocket:
ops-bot: Note: no infra deploys scheduled yet. This thread recorded as planning.
